name: quote-slider
issues: The slider's slot holds two quote cards wider than the content column, so the second card runs off the edge; the lab clips it. How the slider moves (drag, buttons) is not in the file.
The quote cards have no avatar image in this frame, though the author row has room for one.
Text layers have no meaningful names (quote, name and role are bare text nodes).
The quote text uses a hanging opening quote mark through a text indent expressed as a multiple of px, which does not translate to CSS directly; it is approximated with a text-indent of -0.45em.
